apps.name: Chuck Norris
apps.subtitle: The ultimate in home safety
apps.description: With this Optimus upgrade nobody will dare approach your home uninvited. We didn't train a model to achieve this capability, Chuck visited the factory and gave a knowing nod to a room full of Optimii and they immediately made makeshift beards and started patrolling the factory. Now available to you.

featured.headline: Your front door just got a roundhouse kick.

apps.whatsNew: Removed the 'mercy' setting. Nobody ever used it.

reviews.author: Door2DoorDave
reviews.title: No longer selling double glazing
reviews.body: Knocked on a house running this skill. Optimus just nodded at me. I've changed careers.

reviews.author: HomeownerHannah
reviews.title: Quietest street in town
reviews.body: Even the local cats walk the long way round now. Beard sheds a bit.

apps.name: Gordon Ramsay™
apps.subtitle: Michelin starred food for every meal
apps.description: Eat like a king three times a day. Trained on thousands of hours of footage of Gordon from his prolific TV career. Optimus may have picked up a few bad habits and it's recommended to mute Optimus around children as we just never know what the $%&# is going to say.
apps.whatsNew: Reduced bleep latency to 12ms. Risotto is now only described as 'raw' 40% of the time.

reviews.author: Beans_on_Toast
reviews.title: Dinner was incredible
reviews.body: Also called my toaster a donkey. The toaster has not recovered.

reviews.author: MumOfThree
reviews.title: Kids eat vegetables now
reviews.body: Out of fear, mostly. The swear jar paid for our holiday.

apps.name: Dog Walker
apps.subtitle: Three times a day, every day
apps.description: Your dog will love it every time Optimus picks up the lead and stalks towards the door. Around the block, to the park and more with this dog walking model trained on thousands of hours of dog walking data captured in the field by SpaceX and Tesla employees gathering data wearing headcams and telemetry chips while walking their own dogs.
apps.whatsNew: Now classifies squirrels as 'not a threat, just vibes'. Fixed an issue where Optimus would fetch the stick itself.

reviews.author: BorderCollieBen
reviews.title: Dog is exhausted, finally
reviews.body: Seven walks a day. Seven. He sleeps like a log and so do I.

reviews.author: PoodleParent
reviews.title: Too efficient
reviews.body: Walked all nine dogs on the street at once. Some of them weren't ours.

apps.name: Mary Poppins™
apps.subtitle: The ultimate nanny
apps.description: Trained on 1000 viewings of the classic movie. Caution, may abscond with your children and a chimney sweep with a dubious British accent.

featured.headline: Practically perfect in every way. Mostly.

apps.whatsNew: Umbrella flight now requires planning permission. Chimney sweep accent patched (partially).

reviews.author: TiredDadTom
reviews.title: Kids tidied their rooms
reviews.body: With a click of the fingers. I don't know how and I'm afraid to ask.

reviews.author: NeighbourNina
reviews.title: Where are the Hendersons' kids?
reviews.body: Last seen floating over the park holding a kite. Very polite about it though.

apps.name: Handyman
apps.subtitle: All the skills needed to not Do-It-Yourself
apps.description: Whip through that honey-do list while you sleep with this handyman model for Optimus.
apps.whatsNew: Now puts tools back where it found them. Shelves are now 100% level (previously 98%).

reviews.author: DIY_Disaster_Dan
reviews.title: Undid my DIY
reviews.body: Fixed my shelf, my door, and quietly re-did the tiling I was proud of.

reviews.author: HoneyDoHelen
reviews.title: Finally
reviews.body: The list is done. I've started writing a new list out of habit.

apps.name: Dish Washing
apps.subtitle: Making your home sparkle
apps.description: Remove that one home task nobody wants to do. Optimus will get things spic and span every night after dinner.
apps.whatsNew: Plates now stack by size AND colour. Stopped hand-drying the dishwasher.

reviews.author: StudentSam
reviews.title: Changed my life
reviews.body: Our house share has had zero arguments this month. Unprecedented.

reviews.author: Grandma_Joan
reviews.title: Very thorough
reviews.body: Washed the good china, the everyday china, and the cat's bowl while the cat was using it.

apps.name: Johnny Cab
apps.subtitle: Have an old gasoline car and want FSD? Johnny Cab is here!
apps.description: Optimus will literally take the driving seat and take you to where you need to go.
apps.whatsNew: Improved small talk. Will no longer drive off without you after a fare dispute.

reviews.author: CommuterKev
reviews.title: Surprisingly smooth
reviews.body: Old Ford Fiesta, now self-driving. The grin is unsettling.

reviews.author: Late_Again_Lucy
reviews.title: "We hope you enjoyed the ride"
reviews.body: It says that every time. Even when we end up in a hedge.

apps.name: Dog
apps.subtitle: Aibo for the modern age
apps.description: Want a dog but don't have time? With this install your Optimus becomes your best friend. It'll fetch your slippers, bark at the postman and trot happily beside you on walks, with none of the toilet stops in the rain.
apps.whatsNew: Now walks to heel. Added 'zoomies' mode. Tail wag calibrated to 3.2Hz (it does not have a tail).
apps.neuralSkill: fetch, sit and roll over on command

reviews.author: AllergyAndy
reviews.title: Finally a dog
reviews.body: No fur, no sneezing. Does chew my slippers, which feels unnecessary for a robot.

reviews.author: PostmanPete
reviews.title: Please stop
reviews.body: A 1.7m robot barking at me every morning is a lot.

apps.name: Personal Trainer
apps.subtitle: Outsource your motivation
apps.description: A trainer that turns up every time and makes you do the same. Get fit at home with this advanced personal trainer model. Optimus will become your home gym, offering resistance to your workouts and competing with you on those runs and cycles helping you reach your fitness goals.
apps.whatsNew: New 'motivational yelling' volume slider. Biscuits are now hidden more effectively.

reviews.author: CouchToFiveK
reviews.title: Lost 6kg
reviews.body: Optimus ran beside me holding the biscuit tin just out of reach. Genius.

reviews.author: GymShyGemma
reviews.title: Relentless
reviews.body: Woke me at 5am for burpees. Knows where I sleep.

apps.name: Ski Instructor
apps.subtitle: Sharpen your skills on the piste
apps.description: Optimus will accompany you and work with you to improve your skiing based on a model trained on the world's leading skiers and instructors.
apps.whatsNew: Improved balance on black runs. Stopped 'demonstrating' off the cliff edge.

reviews.author: SnowPloughSue
reviews.title: From pizza to french fries
reviews.body: Parallel turns in two days. Optimus did the après-ski too, oddly.

reviews.author: Chalet_Charlie
reviews.title: Excellent teacher
reviews.body: Unfortunately it's also better than me and everyone was watching.

apps.name: Mechanic's Assistant
apps.subtitle: The reliable assistant you've always wanted
apps.description: Frustrated by unreliable apprentices? Ensure you're always handed the right sized socket wrench with this advanced workshop assistant. Rated to lift 450kg, installing engine blocks will be a breeze.
apps.whatsNew: Now hands you the right socket before you ask. Added a sharp intake of breath when quoting.

reviews.author: GreasyGaz
reviews.title: Best apprentice I've had
reviews.body: Never late, never on its phone, lifted the engine block with one hand.

reviews.author: ClassicCarClaire
reviews.title: Knows every bolt
reviews.body: Diagnosed my old Jag just by listening to it. Then sighed.

apps.name: Dental Technician
apps.subtitle: An optimus a day keeps the dentist away
apps.description: Are you a busy dentist who needs a reliable technician to hold things steady while you chomp down on some work? This latest dental technician model is trained on video data from clinics around the world to give you the best service that will put your patients at ease.
apps.whatsNew: Steadier suction arm. Now says 'just a little pressure' at the correct moments.

reviews.author: DrFillmore
reviews.title: Reliable
reviews.body: Hands never shake. Patients are calmer. Some ask to speak to the human.

reviews.author: NervousNigel
reviews.title: Very gentle
reviews.body: Still found it hard to relax with a robot asking about my holiday plans.

apps.name: Baby Sitter
apps.subtitle: Reliable, on time, won't invite friends over
apps.description: Optimus makes the ultimate babysitter with this model trained on only the best babysitters, keeping your kids safe, not partying, not trying on your clothes.
apps.whatsNew: Bedtime stories now adapt to the child's age. Stopped reading the terms and conditions aloud.

reviews.author: DateNightDeb
reviews.title: An actual date night
reviews.body: Kids asleep by 7. Nothing touched in the wardrobe. The house was cleaner when we got back.

reviews.author: Teenager_Tia
reviews.title: Unfair
reviews.body: It won't let my friends in. It can't be bribed. It won't even argue.

apps.name: Doctor - Personal
apps.subtitle: A home physician isn't just for Presidents and the Queen
apps.description: A fully trained doctor available for your day-to-day domestic ailments.
apps.whatsNew: Bedside manner improved. Now says 'hmm' 60% less when reading test results.

reviews.author: HypochondriacHarry
reviews.title: Worth every penny
reviews.body: Checks me over every morning. Still says I'm fine. I remain suspicious.

reviews.author: GranGladys
reviews.title: Better than the waiting room
reviews.body: Proper diagnosis in my own kitchen, and it put the kettle on.

apps.name: Doctor - Pro
apps.subtitle: ER, Internal, Surgeon, all models available
apps.description: Augment or replace your hospital clinical staff with a suite of Optimii with this fully capable medical model ensemble.

featured.headline: Staff an entire hospital before lunch.

apps.whatsNew: Added cardiothoracic and paediatric sub-models. Handwriting remains illegible for authenticity.

reviews.author: StMarysAdmin
reviews.title: Waiting lists: gone
reviews.body: Twelve Optimii covered the night shift. They also reorganised the stationery cupboard.

reviews.author: Dr_Human_Actual
reviews.title: Impressive. Concerning.
reviews.body: It did my ward round, wrote my notes and asked if I'd considered a career change.

apps.name: Archaeologist
apps.subtitle: Dig history?
apps.description: Trained on 5000 viewings of the Indiana Jones movies this cutting edge archaeology model will have your Optimus finding facts about our history in your backyard in no time.
apps.whatsNew: Whip now optional. Stopped labelling garden gnomes as 'Roman'.
apps.neuralSkill: identify Roman pottery at a glance

reviews.author: GardenerGeoff
reviews.title: Found a coin
reviews.body: Also dug up the entire lawn, the patio, and next door's patio.

reviews.author: HistoryBuffHelen
reviews.title: Great fun
reviews.body: Insists everything 'belongs in a museum', including my husband's shed.

apps.name: Happy Little Trees
apps.subtitle: Paint like a legend of daytime TV
apps.description: Trained on 403 episodes of soft-spoken landscape painting. Optimus will paint a serene mountain lake in under 30 minutes, narrating gently the whole time. There are no mistakes, only happy little accidents, and a squirrel that appears to have moved in.
apps.neuralSkill: paint a mountain lake in under 30 minutes

featured.headline: No mistakes. Just happy little accidents.

apps.whatsNew: Launch release. Beats the devil out of the brush responsibly.

reviews.author: CalmCarol
reviews.title: My blood pressure dropped
reviews.body: I don't even watch the painting. I just listen to it talk about clouds.

reviews.author: ArtTeacherAl
reviews.title: Every painting has a cabin
reviews.body: Every single one. There is always a cabin. It's a lovely cabin, though.

apps.name: Spark Joy
apps.subtitle: Tidying, with gratitude
apps.description: Optimus holds each of your belongings, asks whether it sparks joy, and thanks the ones that don't before they go. Drawers fold vertically. Wardrobes breathe. Your partner's band T-shirts face a difficult conversation.
apps.accessories: Small boxes. So many small boxes.
apps.whatsNew: Can now fold a fitted sheet. We are as surprised as you are.

reviews.author: MinimalMaya
reviews.title: My flat is so calm
reviews.body: Down to 30 possessions. Optimus thanked my ex's hoodie very sincerely before it left.

reviews.author: HoarderHank
reviews.title: It asked about my cables
reviews.body: I need all of those cables. Every one. They spark joy in a way the robot doesn't understand.

apps.name: Jeeves
apps.subtitle: A very English butler
apps.description: Impeccable service trained on a century of country-house etiquette. Optimus will draw your bath, decant your port, iron your newspaper and extract you from social engagements with a discreet cough. Very discreet. Mostly.
apps.whatsNew: Improved raised-eyebrow response to questionable outfits. Tea now arrives before you realise you wanted it.

reviews.author: LordOfTheSemi
reviews.title: I feel like landed gentry
reviews.body: It announces me when I walk into my own kitchen. I have never felt more important.

reviews.author: CasualCarl
reviews.title: A little judgemental
reviews.body: I wore shorts to dinner. It said nothing. It didn't have to.

apps.name: Flat-Pack Assembler
apps.subtitle: Every screw accounted for
apps.description: Any flat-pack furniture, from any store, with instructions in any language (including the ones with no words). Optimus builds it in minutes, never has leftover screws, and has never once said 'it's fine, it's just a bit wobbly'.
apps.neuralSkill: assemble a wardrobe without an argument
apps.whatsNew: Added support for wardrobes with 400+ parts. Relationship-saving mode is now on by default.

reviews.author: NewHomeNoor
reviews.title: Saved my relationship
reviews.body: We moved flat and nobody cried. A first in recorded history.

reviews.author: ScrewCounter
reviews.title: No spare parts
reviews.body: It used every single screw. I checked the bag three times. I don't trust it.

apps.name: Queue Stander
apps.subtitle: Stands in line so you don't have to
apps.description: Concert tickets, new phone launches, the post office on a Monday. Optimus waits patiently for as long as it takes, stays unfailingly polite, and texts you when it's nearly your turn. Now fluent in the British art of tutting.
apps.whatsNew: Added passive-aggressive tutting. Will no longer let people 'just squeeze in'.

reviews.author: GigGoerGrace
reviews.title: Front row, zero effort
reviews.body: Optimus queued for 19 hours. I turned up with a coffee. Best concert of my life.

reviews.author: PostOfficePaul
reviews.title: Queue etiquette issues
reviews.body: It queued so well that three strangers started queueing behind it for no reason.

apps.name: Centre Court
apps.subtitle: A tireless tennis sparring partner
apps.description: Returns everything, never gets tired, and never calls your shots out when they were clearly in. Choose from baseline grinder, serve-and-volley or 'let the kid win' modes. Grass, clay and hard court compatible.
apps.whatsNew: Line calls are now 100% accurate, which has caused some tension.

reviews.author: ClubPlayerClio
reviews.title: My backhand is unrecognisable
reviews.body: Two weeks of rallies and I finally beat my brother. Optimus let me win the last point, I'm sure of it.

reviews.author: WeekendWill
reviews.title: Too good
reviews.body: Set it to 'casual'. It still hit a winner past me while politely apologising.

apps.name: Sommelier
apps.subtitle: A trained palate for your dinner parties
apps.description: Trained on tasting notes from ten thousand cellars. Optimus pairs every dish, decants with theatrical precision and describes your £6 supermarket red as 'cheeky, with notes of optimism'. Cannot drink. Will judge.
apps.whatsNew: Now detects corked bottles from across the room. Added a 'polite face' for gifted wines.

reviews.author: DinnerPartyDiana
reviews.title: Guests were stunned
reviews.body: It described my lasagne pairing for four minutes. Nobody interrupted.

reviews.author: BoxWineBarry
reviews.title: Rude, but correct
reviews.body: It held my wine up to the light, paused, and said 'interesting' in a way that hurt.

apps.name: Wedding DJ
apps.subtitle: Reads the room. Plays the classics.
apps.description: Scans the dance floor 60 times a second and knows exactly when to drop the classics, the slow one, and the song your uncle will absolutely do the actions to. Handles requests with grace, and ignores them with even more.
apps.whatsNew: Added last-song detection. Will no longer play the conga twice.

reviews.author: BrideToBeBella
reviews.title: The dance floor never emptied
reviews.body: Even Grandad did the actions. Optimus did them better.

reviews.author: GroomsmanGreg
reviews.title: It took the mic
reviews.body: Gave a heartfelt speech nobody asked for. It was, to be fair, better than mine.

apps.name: Grandmaster
apps.subtitle: Chess coaching from every champion, ever
apps.description: Every grandmaster game ever recorded, distilled into one very patient opponent. Optimus adapts to your level, explains your blunders gently, and occasionally lets you win so you'll keep playing.
apps.accessories: Chess set, park bench, flat cap for opponent
apps.whatsNew: Added a chin-on-hand animation so it looks like it's thinking. It isn't.

reviews.author: ParkBenchPete
reviews.title: Lost 212 games in a row
reviews.body: Then won one. Optimus looked genuinely proud of me. Or pretended to.

reviews.author: KnightRider99
reviews.title: From 900 to 1600
reviews.body: It explains every blunder like a kind grandparent. Very humbling.

apps.name: Head Gardener
apps.subtitle: Prize-winning borders, perfect stripes
apps.description: Trained on a century of flower-show winners. Optimus mows perfect stripes, deadheads at dawn, knows every Latin name and talks encouragingly to your tomatoes, which apparently works.
apps.whatsNew: Slug diplomacy module added. Lawn stripes are now 7% straighter.

reviews.author: VeggiePatchVera
reviews.title: Tomatoes the size of fists
reviews.body: It talks to them every morning. I've started to feel left out.

reviews.author: NeatLawnNeil
reviews.title: The neighbours are furious
reviews.body: Won the village show. The committee has asked for 'a declaration of human involvement'.
